15728.format: Group Stage: four groups of five play a single round robin, all BO2. Bottom team in each is eliminated. The remaining sixteen play eight BO3 seeding deciders; winners enter the playoff upper bracket and losers the lower bracket. Playoffs: sixteen-team double elimination, BO3 throughout except the BO5 grand final. Archived opponent choices supply the seeding template. Event-specific group tiebreak rules are still under review.
limitations: The complete dated stages are recovered, but TI2023's distinct elimination/seeding tiebreak rules require review before play.
15728.notes: Valve records distinguish BO3 elimination tiebreaks from BO1 seeding tiebreaks. Keep this field unavailable until the complete conditional policy is implemented.

16935.format: Group Stage: four groups of four, single round robin, all BO2. Nobody is eliminated. Seeding Deciders: eight BO3 matches between the top two and the other group's lower two (A/B and C/D). Winners enter the playoff upper bracket, losers the lower bracket. Playoffs: sixteen-team double elimination; all BO3 except the BO5 grand final. Group ties for first/second or second/third require BO3; third/fourth remain tied. Three-way ties use BO1 round robin with only the required positions contested; a four-way tie uses the documented five-match BO1 placement bracket. Archived opponent choices supply the seeding template.
16935.notes: Names are event-era identities. Group C's bottom pair remain tied; ordering them in a seed template does not create another played game.
